summary: Frontend mobile optimization testing for bridal makeup artist portfolio site. All 8 mobile UX features verified working correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All mobile optimization features verified. MobileBookBar shows correctly on mobile (390px) after 400px scroll, hidden on desktop (1920px via lg:hidden). FloatingButtons at bottom-20 (80px) on mobile. Services show 'Explore' on mobile, full text on desktop. Contact CTAs stack full-width on mobile. Footer 2-column grid on mobile. Process cards at 82vw (~319.8px at 390px viewport) with snap-x mandatory.

test_results.MobileBookBar_visible_mobile: PASS - shows after scrolling ~400px with 'Book Free Consultation' button and WhatsApp icon
test_results.MobileBookBar_hidden_desktop: PASS - lg:hidden correctly hides it at 1920px viewport
test_results.FloatingButtons_repositioned: PASS - computed bottom: 80px (bottom-20 = 5rem = 80px) on mobile, not overlapping MobileBookBar
test_results.Services_explore_label: PASS - 'Explore' shows on mobile, 'View X portfolio' shows on desktop
test_results.Contact_CTAs_full_width: PASS - flex-direction: column on mobile, buttons are w-full (350px wide at 390px)
test_results.Process_horizontal_scroll: PASS - 4 cards, 82vw wide (319.797px at 390px viewport), snap-x mandatory
test_results.Contact_form_works: PASS - form inputs functional on mobile
test_results.Desktop_no_layout_issues: PASS - clean desktop render, no console errors
